name.value: CRAFT Beer Market (Olympic Village / False Creek)

description.value: CRAFT Beer Market False Creek occupies a historic 1930s Salt Building in Vancouver's Olympic Village, reimagined as a multi-level pub and restaurant with views of False Creek, the city skyline, and the North Shore mountains. The venue is LEED Gold and LEAF certified, making it one of Canada's most sustainably designed restaurants. Cyclists riding the False Creek seawall will find a full-service food and drink stop with brunch, late-night options, and both indoor and covered patio seating.
